sample_representation: all 2085 frozen evaluation genes in log1p(CP10K), without PCA compression
training_cells: all train and permitted vehicle controls in frozen split_v1
optimizer: scvi-tools 0.13 default Adam, learning rate 0.001, weight decay 1e-06
delta: mean posterior latent of the drug's 10000 nM training cells minus mean posterior latent of all vehicle controls
prediction_source: 512 vehicle controls drawn without replacement per condition with numpy default_rng(10000 + seed)
prediction_decoder: deterministic decoder mean px, module in eval mode
prediction_postprocessing: clip negative predicted log-expression to zero; no renormalization or rounding
early_stopping_note: scvi-tools 0.13 early stopping monitors elbo_validation with the unweighted KL; under kl_weight 5e-05 it is minimal at epoch 1 and always stops training at epoch 26 (see config_early_stopping.json)
